##### Project general facts

Suburbia is a residential apartment development by DAMAC Properties, comprising two distinctive towers that offer a mix of spacious duplex residences and single-floor apartments. The project stands out for its architecture inspired by traditional Moroccan design, incorporating vibrant colors, geometric patterns, and decorative elements that give the development a unique character. The duplex residences are designed to combine the practicality of apartment living with the spacious feel of a villa, creating an attractive option for residents seeking both comfort and style.

The development provides a lifestyle-oriented environment with features that enhance everyday living. One of the highlights of the duplex units is the inclusion of private terraces that extend the living space outdoors and offer a more exclusive residential experience. Beautifully landscaped surroundings contribute to the community atmosphere, creating pleasant outdoor spaces for relaxation and leisure while complementing the project's distinctive architectural identity.

The interiors are completed with quality fixtures and fittings, ensuring a comfortable and functional living environment. Apartments feature fitted kitchens equipped with essential appliances, including a washer, dryer, oven, refrigerator, and other household necessities. As furnishing details are not specified, the residences can be described as offering high-quality modern interiors designed for convenience and practicality, with a focus on efficient everyday living.

##### Location description and benefits

Downtown Jebel Ali is becoming one of Dubai’s most desirable places to live and work, with its convenient location and easy connections. Jebel Ali is where Dubai’s major road, seaport, and Metro line converge, and is within easy reach of the UAE’s fast-growing capital city, Abu Dhabi. Nearby, the new Al Maktoum International Airport, set to become the largest in the world, will connect Jebel Ali to all corners of the globe.

Jebel Ali Free Zone is one of the world’s largest and fastest growing Free Zones, home to over 7,000 companies, including more than 100 of the Fortune 500. It accounts for 50% of Dubai’s total exports and opens up business opportunities from a potential market of over two billion people in the greater Middle Eastern region.

Overlooking Gate 5 of the Jebel Ali Free Zone, DAMAC Suburbia is one of the first premium apartment complexes nestled within a predominantly commercial area. With its convenient location and direct views of Sheikh Zayed Road, DAMAC Suburbia is easily accessible from Dubai and Abu Dhabi. One of the world’s largest themed malls is also close by, and ready for retail therapy at a moment’s notice
